The user wants a summary of the causes of the French Revolution in five paragraphs, followed by a list of ten key dates. Let me organize my thoughts.

Five paragraphs on causes:
1. Social/structural causes - the three estates system, inequality, the burden on the Third Estate
2. Economic causes - debt, taxation, bad harvests, fiscal crisis
3. Political/institutional causes - the monarchy's inability to reform, the Estates-General, the failure of the old political system
4. Intellectual/ideological causes - Enlightenment ideas, influence of the American Revolution
5. Immediate triggers - the financial crisis of the 1780s, Louis XVI's inability to govern, the calling of the Estates-General in 1789

Ten key dates:
- May 5, 1789 – Estates-General convenes at Versailles
- June 17, 1789 – Tennis Court Oath
- June 20, 1789 – Third Estate declares itself the National Assembly
- July 14, 1789 – Storming of the Bastille
- August 4, 1789 – Abolition of feudalism
- August 26, 1789 – Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
- October 5-6, 1789 – Women's March on Versailles
- June 20, 1791 – Flight to Varennes (Louis XVI attempts to flee)
- August 10, 1792 – Storming of the Tuileries, end of the monarchy
- September 22, 1792 – First Republic declared / Battle of Valmy
- January 21, 1793 – Execution of Louis XVI
